args.body: Hi Eve! I visited your blog. It's nice and personal, and I like that your love of hiking comes through. It would be even better with some posts about your hikes, such as photos, favorite trails and tips. A bit more content and some navigation would also make it easier to explore. Great start!

Hi Dora! I visited your personal website. It's clean and simple, and having your contact email up front is handy. You could make it more engaging by adding a short bio, details about your projects or interests, and some visuals. Nice start!

final_text:
I visited both websites and sent each person feedback.

- **Dora:** I invited her to Slack using the email on her site (dora@gmail.com), then messaged her. I said her site is clean and simple, and that having her email up front is handy. I suggested adding a short bio, details about her projects or interests, and some visuals.
- **Eve:** I messaged her that her blog feels personal and that her love of hiking comes through. I suggested posts about her hikes, such as photos, favorite trails and tips. I also suggested more content and some navigation.
